lessons.title: Meet the crew
lessons.focus: Use a polite morning greeting, give your name with ～です, and ask a worker's name before confirming a role. The topic particle は is pronounced wa. Read the short lines in hiragana before introducing site kanji.
lessons.scene: A supervisor and carpenter meet at the morning check-in
terms: おはようございます|good morning (polite)
よろしくおねがいします|pleased to work with you
dialogue: おはようございます。|Good morning.
おはようございます。|Good morning.
わたしは さとうです。|I am Sato.
きょうの げんばかんとくです。|I am today's site supervisor.
おなまえは なんですか。|What is your name?
わたしは たなかです。|I am Tanaka.
だいくです。|I am a carpenter.
たなかさん、よろしくおねがいします。|Tanaka, I look forward to working with you.
